requirements.title: Durable workspace identity
requirements.gate: Create a workspace, a document, a note, a notebook and a source through the public API, then read back each assigned id and its schema version.

requirements.title: Durable source archive
requirements.gate: Ingest a source, restart the backend, then read back the retained original, its chunks and its metadata from the durable source archive.

requirements.title: Safe atomic saves
requirements.gate: Interrupt a vault note write and a notebook manifest write, then read both files back and find the previous contents intact.

requirements.title: Recovery and version restore
requirements.gate: Kill the process mid-edit, restart it, then restore the acknowledged draft and the previous version from the recovery journal.

requirements.title: External change detection
requirements.gate: Change a note on disk behind the editor, reopen it, then read a conflict copy instead of the overwritten draft.

requirements.title: Persistent job progress
requirements.gate: Cancel a running generation job, restart the service and resume the run, then read back that no duplicate artifact was written.

requirements.title: Unified navigation across workspaces
requirements.gate: Open the command palette, quick-open a document, a note and a notebook, then read back the visible search scope for each.

requirements.title: Local operation without a provider
requirements.gate: Turn the provider off, edit a document and run a lexical search, then read the run log and find the stub named as the provider.

requirements.title: Installable local delivery
requirements.gate: Build the desktop package, install it on a clean machine, then start the app and the local services from the installed launcher.

requirements.title: Accessible operation of every workflow
requirements.gate: Complete a document edit, a note edit and a notebook answer with the keyboard alone, then read the screen-reader semantics of each step.

requirements.title: Document creation and outline editing
requirements.gate: Create a book, add a titled section, rename it, reorder it and reopen the book, then read back the section order.

requirements.title: Persistent block and run model
requirements.gate: Edit a paragraph through the document operation API, then read back the anchored runs and confirm no section string became the authority.

requirements.title: Selection formatting and paragraph styles
requirements.gate: Select a span in a paragraph, apply bold, a heading style and a list level, then read back the run and paragraph properties.

requirements.title: Undo, clipboard, find and statistics
requirements.gate: Undo and redo an edit, paste rich text, run a find and replace, then read back the document word count.

requirements.title: Independent human writing
requirements.gate: Write a section, save it and reopen it with no provider configured, then read the run log and find no model call.

requirements.title: Edits preserve surrounding rich structure
requirements.gate: Change one word in an imported rich paragraph, export the DOCX, then read back that the styles, links and anchored objects around it survived.

requirements.title: Real page layout and pagination
requirements.gate: Lay out a 100-page document with margins, sections and page numbers, then read back the page break positions from the layout result.

requirements.title: Visual table editing
requirements.gate: Add a row and a column to a table, merge two cells and repeat the header row, then read back the resulting cell placements.

requirements.title: Image insertion and placement
requirements.gate: Insert a PNG into a document with a caption and a description, export the DOCX, then read back the drawing and its extent.

requirements.title: Links, footnotes and cross-references
requirements.gate: Author a hyperlink, a bookmark and a footnote in a document, then read them back from the exported DOCX package.

requirements.title: Table of contents and bibliography
requirements.gate: Insert a table of contents and a bibliography into a document, then read back the resolved citation metadata for each entry.

requirements.title: Print preview and PDF export
requirements.gate: Export a laid-out document to PDF from the print preview, then reopen the PDF and read back the page count and the text of each page.

requirements.title: Spellcheck and dictionaries
requirements.gate: Type a misspelled word in a paragraph, then read back the dictionary suggestions and the document language setting.

requirements.title: DOCX feature matrix
requirements.gate: Publish the DOCX feature matrix, then read one row per feature carrying read, display, edit, preserve, export and a stated limitation.

requirements.title: Anchored comments and discussions
requirements.gate: Anchor a comment on a paragraph, write a reply, resolve it and reopen the DOCX, then read the thread back from the package.

requirements.title: Tracked changes authoring
requirements.gate: Insert and delete text with tracking on, export the DOCX, then read back the revision elements with their author and date.

requirements.title: Version comparison and AI edit review
requirements.gate: Compare two saved versions of a document and read the differing sections, then read a proposed AI edit back as an explicit change.

requirements.title: Styles, fields, forms and mail merge
requirements.gate: Apply a reusable style set, insert a field and a content control, then read the definitions back from the exported DOCX.

requirements.title: Coauthoring, presence and permissions
requirements.gate: Two clients edit one document under different roles, then read the convergence record and the denied write in the server log.

requirements.title: Legacy doc and macro handling
requirements.gate: Open a legacy .doc file, then read the compatibility note that names the macro and embedded-object limits of the import.

requirements.title: Markdown source and reading modes
requirements.gate: Open a note in source and reading modes and switch between them, then read the markdown back unchanged.

requirements.title: Safe rendering of markdown constructs
requirements.gate: Render a note holding a table, a code fence, a callout and a task list, then read back the rendered blocks and the escaped raw HTML.

requirements.title: Wiki-link aliases and references
requirements.gate: Follow an aliased wiki-link, a heading reference and a block reference, then read back the resolved target and the unresolved-link report.

requirements.title: Attachments and relative links
requirements.gate: Paste an image into a note and link to a file beside it, then read back the attachment path and confirm no file moved.

requirements.title: Typed frontmatter properties
requirements.gate: Write a note with typed frontmatter properties, reopen it, then read back the property values with the unknown YAML left intact.

requirements.title: Daily notes, templates and saved searches
requirements.gate: Create a daily note from a template and save a search, then reopen the vault and read both back by name.

requirements.title: Recoverable rename with backlink rewriting
requirements.gate: Rename a linked note, interrupt the rename, then read back the note, its rewritten backlinks and the trash entry that restores it.

requirements.title: Incremental vault index and file watching
requirements.gate: Change one note on disk, wait for the watcher, then read back the updated index entry and the vault load count for the session.

requirements.title: Vault search with query semantics
requirements.gate: Run a path, tag and full-text query, then read back the ranked hits, their snippets and the filters that were applied.

requirements.title: Graph views of the vault
requirements.gate: Open the local and global graph view of a 10,000-note vault, then read back the rendered node count and the applied filters.

requirements.title: Canvas with portable JSON export
requirements.gate: Build a canvas of cards and connections, export it as JSON Canvas and import it back, then read the card set on both sides.

requirements.title: Property-driven table and card views
requirements.gate: Define a table view over a note property, then read back the rows in the same order after a restart.

requirements.title: Multi-device sync with offline edits
requirements.gate: Edit the same note offline on two devices, reconnect them, then read back the merged result with no silent data loss.

requirements.title: Extension and command API
requirements.gate: Install a minimal extension through the declared API, then read back the permission it was granted and the commands it registered.

requirements.title: Publishing selected notes
requirements.gate: Publish a selected note with its attachments, then read back the published link and the private-link check that ran.

requirements.title: Notebook sources survive a restart
requirements.gate: Ask a notebook, restart the backend and desktop, then ask again and read the explicit report of any missing or changed source.

requirements.title: Source reader with exact locators
requirements.gate: Open a source in the reader, jump to a page and a character span, then read back the highlighted excerpt and its offsets.

requirements.title: Per-question source selection
requirements.gate: Deselect one source for a question, ask it, then read back the citations and confirm the deselected source was excluded.

requirements.title: Vault notes as explicit evidence
requirements.gate: Select a vault note as evidence, ask a question, then read back the note identity and the content revision each answer was bound to.

requirements.title: Persisted multi-turn conversations
requirements.gate: Hold a three-turn conversation, restart the backend, then read back every turn with its sources, its citations and its feedback.

requirements.title: Streamed answers with cancellation
requirements.gate: Stream an answer, cancel it mid-flight and retry, then read back the partial answer and the recorded cancellation.

requirements.title: Claim-level evidence evaluation
requirements.gate: Ask a question whose answer carries one supported and one unsupported claim, then read back the per-claim verdict for each.

requirements.title: Separation of relevance, identity and support
requirements.gate: Evaluate an answer, then read back the retrieval rank, the exact citation identity and the semantic support score as separate fields.

requirements.title: Contradiction handling and abstention
requirements.gate: Ask a question two sources contradict and one they cannot answer, then read back the contradiction report and the refusal.

requirements.title: Persisted retrieval index and recall benchmark
requirements.gate: Persist a retrieval index across a restart, then read back the recall and the citation-precision figures for the curated corpus.

requirements.title: Expanded ingestion coverage
requirements.gate: Ingest a PDF, a DOCX, an HTML page, a Markdown file and a pasted text, then read back the extraction quality and the omissions for each.

requirements.title: Audio and video ingestion
requirements.gate: Ingest an audio file and a video transcript, then read back the timestamped transcript and the original reference for each.

requirements.title: Web discovery and document connectors
requirements.gate: Resolve a DOI through the resolver chain, then read back the captured version so a refresh cannot alter an old answer.

requirements.title: Editable summaries and briefing documents
requirements.gate: Draft a section from a notebook's sources, edit the draft and save it, then read back the draft and its evidence links.

requirements.title: Flashcards, quizzes and study progress
requirements.gate: Generate a flashcard set and a quiz from a notebook, then read back each answer key checked against its evidence.

requirements.title: Audio overviews
requirements.gate: Generate an audio overview with its source-linked script, play it and download it, then read back the script and its references.

requirements.title: Video overviews and slide decks
requirements.gate: Generate a slide deck from a notebook, then reopen it and read back the script, the references and the generation settings.

requirements.title: Persisted artifact jobs and versions
requirements.gate: Generate a study pack, restart the backend and reopen it, then read back its provenance, its version and its export.

requirements.title: Notebook sharing with roles
requirements.gate: Share a notebook with a reader role, then attempt a source download and read back the denial and the revocation.

requirements.title: Provider usage, cost and privacy
requirements.gate: Start an operation that calls a remote provider, then read back the usage, the estimated cost and the privacy choice shown before it ran.

requirements.title: Shared project workspace manifest
requirements.gate: Open one project that holds a document, a note, a notebook and a source, then read back the stable id each entry is linked by.

requirements.title: Promote a cited passage into a note
requirements.gate: Promote a quoted passage into a vault note, then read back the note's locator, the source id and the source revision it carries.

requirements.title: Promote research into an editable document
requirements.gate: Build an outline from a notebook's notes, open it as a book, edit a section, then read back the provenance each section kept.

requirements.title: Add a document to notebook research
requirements.gate: Add a document section to a notebook, then read back the manifest entry that says whether it is a snapshot or a live link.

requirements.title: Navigate from claim to evidence
requirements.gate: Open a manuscript claim, jump to the chunk that supports it and back, then read the stale flag after the claim was edited.

requirements.title: Portable project bundle export and import
requirements.gate: Export a project bundle, import it on a clean installation, then read back the notes, documents, originals, artifacts and manifest it carried.

requirements.title: Compatibility corpus
requirements.gate: Run the corpus over edited and untouched round trips, then read back the manifest entry that names each fixture and its outcome.

requirements.title: Export comparison against real Word
requirements.gate: Export a document, compare its semantic structure and rendered pages with the fixtures, then read back the Word validation result.

requirements.title: Fault injection and recovery
requirements.gate: Fill the disk, deny a write and kill the process mid-save, then read back the acknowledged edit and the recoverable conflict.

requirements.title: Reversibility and clean-installation restore
requirements.gate: Import a project bundle on a clean installation, restore a backup, then read back the documents, notes and sources that came back.

requirements.title: Measured latency and memory budgets
requirements.gate: Benchmark the 100-page document, the 10,000-note vault and the 100-source notebook, then read back the measured p95 latency and the memory.

requirements.title: Latency separation and UI responsiveness
requirements.gate: Run a long job while editing and navigating, then read back the local-interaction latency measured apart from the model latency.

requirements.title: Boundary limits and input sanitisation
requirements.gate: Submit an oversized upload, a private-host URL and a path that escapes the root, then read back the refusal for each.

requirements.title: Authenticated local gateway
requirements.gate: Call the gateway from a foreign origin and read back the refusal of the mutation, then call it without the installation credential and read back the refusal of that request too.

requirements.title: Secrets in protected storage
requirements.gate: Configure a provider key, read the diagnostics dump, then read back that no key and no document content appears in it.

requirements.title: Access checks on retrieval and export
requirements.gate: Revoke a source, then request retrieval, an artifact export and a source download, then read back the refusal and the preserved history.

requirements.title: Reproducible diagnostics and repair
requirements.gate: Run the diagnostics action, read back the storage and index status, then rebuild the index and read back the rebuilt state.

requirements.title: Platform installation validation
requirements.gate: Install, launch, edit offline, restart the service, upgrade and uninstall on a supported platform, then read back the retained data.
